# Large print collection

Each branch keeps large print fiction and nonfiction near the front entrance. Main Street holds the largest share, about 4,000 titles. New large print comes in monthly from a standing order, and about a third of it goes first to readers in [[Hearthside Visits]].

Patrons can request any large print title from another branch with a regular hold. Worn large print copies are replaced rather than repaired, because readers complain about loose pages.
